mapper.insert: INSERT INTO album (title, image_url, artist_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{imageUrl}, #{artistId})
mapper.select: SELECT album.id, album.title, album.image_url AS imageUrl, artist.id AS artistId, artist.name AS artistName, artist.image_url AS artistImageUrl FROM album JOIN artist ON album.artist_id = artist.id WHERE album.id = #{id}
